result.explanation: Use a state machine with a pre-event expiration check. Advance first increments now, then expiration is checked; all other events check at the current now. A matching offer replaces all prior session data, and two distinct approvals connect before expiry. A counterexample is an accept after the deadline: it must not approve, even if its token matches.
result.mapping: config.ttl and config.parties define expiry and valid identities; state stores now, token, expires, approved, connected, and status; event determines the transition; output is the resulting state plus expired.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated contract. Unknown operations are ignored and report status ignored. Cancel matches either a pending or connected session. Expiry clears only pending sessions.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let c=input.config,s={n:0,t:null,x:null,a:[],g:null},ok=(v)=>v&&typeof v==='object'&&Object.keys(v).length===7;for(let e of input.events){let z=false;if(e.type==='advance')s.n+=e.dt; if(s.x!==null&&s.g===null&&s.n>=s.x){s.t=null;s.x=null;s.a=[];z=true}let q='ignored';if(e.type==='offer'){s.t=e.token;s.x=s.n+c.ttl;s.a=[];s.g=null;q='offered'}else if(e.type==='accept'&&s.g===null&&s.t===e.token&&c.parties.indexOf(e.party)>=0){if(s.a.indexOf(e.party)>=0)q='duplicate';else{s.a.push(e.party);s.a.sort();q='accepted';if(s.a.length===2){s.g=s.t;s.x=null;q='connected'}}}else if(e.type==='cancel'&&e.token===s.t){s.t=null;s.x=null;s.a=[];s.g=null;q='cancelled'}else if(e.type==='advance')q='advanced';let r=output.shift();if(!ok(r)||r.now!==s.n||r.token!==s.t||r.expires!==s.x||r.connected!==s.g||r.expired!==z||r.status!==q||JSON.stringify(r.approved)!==JSON.stringify(s.a))return false}return true}
